entrypoint.do: let origin = ($env.ORIGIN? | default ""); let h = ($origin | str replace -r '^https?://' ''); if ($h == $origin) or ($h | is-empty) or ($h !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9.:-]+$') { print -e $"ORIGIN '($origin)' is no origin: set it to the scheme and host readers reach the door at, as https://app.example"; exit 1 }; let p = (if ($h | str contains ":") { $h | split row ":" | last } else { "8443" }); let tls_port = (if (($env.CADDY_TLS_HOST_PORT? | default "") != "") { $env.CADDY_TLS_HOST_PORT } else { $p }); let work = ($env.BAYT_LOCAL_WORK_DIR? | default $nu.temp-dir); let cdir = ($work | path join $"caddy-($nu.pid)-(random int 1000..9999)"); mkdir ($cdir | path join "data") ($cdir | path join "config"); let env_file = ($cdir | path join "env"); let certs = (($env.CADDY_CERT_DIR? | default ".certs") | path expand | str replace -a (char -u 5c) '/'); let served_dir = ($env.BAYT_LOCAL_SERVED_DIR? | default ""); let is_local = (($served_dir != "") and (($served_dir | path join "srv") | path exists)); let cfg_src = (if $is_local { 'services/proxy/Caddyfile' } else { ($env.CADDY_CONFIG_FILE? | default (if ('services/proxy/Caddyfile' | path exists) { 'services/proxy/Caddyfile' } else { "/etc/caddy/Caddyfile" })) }); mut env_lines = [$"CADDY_TLS_HOST_PORT=($tls_port)"]; mut extra_env = { XDG_DATA_HOME: ($cdir | path join "data"), XDG_CONFIG_HOME: ($cdir | path join "config"), CADDY_TLS_HOST_PORT: $tls_port }; if $is_local { let served_fwd = ($served_dir | path expand | str replace -a (char -u 5c) '/'); let srv_root = $"($served_fwd)/srv"; let omni_root = $"($served_fwd)/omnishell"; $env_lines = ($env_lines | append [$"CADDY_DOOR_PORT=($tls_port)" $"PRONTO_SRV_ROOT=($srv_root)" $"PRONTO_OMNISHELL_ROOT=($omni_root)"]); $extra_env = ($extra_env | merge { CADDY_DOOR_PORT: $tls_port, PRONTO_SRV_ROOT: $srv_root, PRONTO_OMNISHELL_ROOT: $omni_root }) }; if (($certs | path join "localhost.pem") | path exists) { let tv = $"($certs)/localhost.pem ($certs)/localhost-key.pem"; $env_lines = ($env_lines | append $"CADDY_TLS=($tv)"); $extra_env = ($extra_env | merge { CADDY_TLS: $tv }) }; ($env_lines | str join (char nl)) + (char nl) | save -f $env_file; with-env $extra_env { let adapted = (^caddy adapt --envfile $env_file --config $cfg_src --adapter caddyfile); let roots = ($adapted | split row "," | parse -r '"root":"(?<r>[^"]+)"' | get -o r | default [] | uniq); for r in $roots { if ($r | path exists) { glob ($r | path join "**/*" | str replace -a (char -u 5c) '/') | where ($it | path type) == "file" and (not ($it | str ends-with ".etag")) | each {|f| let etag = $"($f).etag"; if (not ($etag | path exists)) { let d = (open --raw $f | hash sha256); ((char dquote) + $d + (char dquote)) | save --raw -f $etag } } | ignore } }; exec caddy run --envfile $env_file --config $cfg_src --adapter caddyfile }

dockerfile.do: case "${ORIGIN#http://}" in "$ORIGIN") h=${ORIGIN#https://};; *) h=${ORIGIN#http://};; esac; case "$h" in "$ORIGIN"|""|*[!A-Za-z0-9.:-]*) echo "ORIGIN '$ORIGIN' is no origin: set it to the scheme and host readers reach the door at, as https://app.example" >&2; exit 1;; esac; : > /etc/caddy/env; case "$h" in *:*) _p=${h##*:};; *) _p=8443;; esac; export CADDY_TLS_HOST_PORT="${CADDY_TLS_HOST_PORT:-$_p}"; printf 'CADDY_TLS_HOST_PORT=%s\n' "$CADDY_TLS_HOST_PORT" >> /etc/caddy/env; if [ -f /certs/localhost.pem ]; then export CADDY_TLS='/certs/localhost.pem /certs/localhost-key.pem'; printf 'CADDY_TLS=%s\n' "$CADDY_TLS" >> /etc/caddy/env; fi; set -e -o pipefail; roots=$(caddy adapt --envfile /etc/caddy/env --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile | awk '{ while (match($0, /"root":"[^"]*"/)) { print substr($0, RSTART + 8, RLENGTH - 9); $0 = substr($0, RSTART + RLENGTH) } }' | sort -u); if [ -n "$roots" ]; then find $roots -type f ! -name '*.etag' -exec sh -c 'set -e; q=$1; shift; for f do h=$(sha256sum < "$f"); printf "$q%s$q" "${h%% *}" > "$f.etag"; done' sh '"' {} +; fi; exec caddy run --envfile /etc/caddy/env --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile
